title: Conversational Email Task Manager
subtitle: Postmark Challenge + Event-Driven Laravel & Livewire
summary: Transforms incoming emails via Postmark Inbound Webhooks into actionable Laravel tasks using hashtags (#priority, #done) with reactive Livewire UI.
overview: Event-driven system that intercepts inbound emails from Postmark Webhooks, parses message body for hashtags (#priority, #done, #delete), and updates interactive task boards in real time.
responsibilities: Configured Postmark Inbound Webhooks and HTTP payload verification.
Engineered regex hashtag parsing engine converting subject/body text into structured tasks.
Built reactive single-page dashboard using Laravel Livewire and Pest test automation.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Processing incoming webhook payloads reliably without dropping requests under load.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Queued inbound webhook processing and verified signatures for security.

metrics: Sub-second task creation directly from email messages
